title: smime-tree key.rs: RecipientIdentifier has no Display impl — appears in user-visible error contexts
description: key.rs: RecipientIdentifier is #[non_exhaustive] and used in error messages (e.g. 'no decryption key matches any recipient'). There is no impl Display for RecipientIdentifier, so callers who want to log which recipient was tried must implement their own formatting. User-visible consequence: error logs from callers implementing custom RevocationChecker or audit logs cannot easily include the identifier that failed to match.
